title: Marketing / Cast of characters
slide_intent: Use a varied cast with distinct poses because inclusion and personality are communicated through who appears and how they act.
strategic_value: A diverse group of recognizable app characters can extend Duolingo’s invitation into marketing.
demonstration: Ten characters with distinct clothing, proportions and expressions appear in two rows beside guidance on grouping and posing.
practical_value: Choose individuals, pairs or the whole cast according to the message and preserve each character’s personality.

content_islands.name: Character repertoire
content_islands.spec: Arrange the ten posed figures in two rows of five, retaining their individual gestures and shadows.

content_islands.name: Inclusion and grouping
content_islands.spec: Explain the cast’s ambassador role and permitted group sizes at upper right.

content_islands.name: Expression guidance
content_islands.spec: Explain why posing matters and why expressionless figures feel lifeless below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source links the cast’s diversity to the message that everyone can use Duolingo and says posing reveals personality.
reference_purposes.Application: Characters may appear all together, in pairs or individually.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source advises avoiding static, expressionless character use.

ingredient.name: Marketing cast
ingredient.role: Express inclusion and personality through recurring characters.
ingredient.application: Use the whole cast, pairs or individuals; choose expressive poses that convey character.
ingredient.scope: Historical app cast and marketing guidance; the figures are not asserted to be the current cast.
